stem: The graph of linear function k passes through the points (−7, 0) and (1, 8). Which statement must be true?

options.label: A
options.text: The slope of the graph of k is \(-\frac{4}{3}\).

options.label: B
options.text: The graph of k passes through the point (−1, −8).

options.label: D
options.text: The x-intercept of the graph of k is −7.

visual_elements: coordinate plane with x-axis and y-axis labeled, grid from -9 to 9 on both axes
